properties.raw_text: Glimepiride showed significant inhibitory effect on losartan at the concentration of 1-10 μmol·L-1 losartan with a Ki value of 0.4077±0.0862 μmol·L-1. Losartan only showed inhibitory effect on glimepiride at the concentration of 1 μmol·L-1 glimepiride. The inhibitory effect of glimepiride on losartan is stronger than that of losartan on glimepiride.
